After the verb स्था 'to stand', preceded by उप , when meaning 'to adore', the आत्मनेपद affix is used.

Terms: आत्मनेपद

After the verb कृ preceded by वि , when used intransitively, the आत्मनेपद is used.

Terms: आत्मनेपद

And when used intransitively after the verb ज्ञ , the आत्मनेपद is used, when the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent.

Terms: आत्मनेपद

And if that कारक which is not spoken of as coming under any of the special relations of Ablation etc., is also called कर्म।

Terms: कारक-कर्म

A word implying 'debt', considered as a 'cause' but not as कर्तृ or agent, takes the 5th case-affix.

Terms: विभक्ति-5

The affix घञ् comes after a root when the sense is that of an appellative, the word being related to the verb from which its name is deduced, but not as agent.

Terms: घञ्

The affix ष्ठल् comes in the sense of 'he goes on by means thereof' after the word आकर्ष।

Terms: ष्ठल्

The word आकालिकट् is irregularly formed in the sense of 'what coincides with the beginning and the end i.e. what lasts only an instant'.

Terms: Irregular

The affix कन् comes in the sense of 'versed therein or skilled therein' after the प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) आकर्ष etc. being in the Locative -7th case in construction.

Terms: कन्

When a single vowel is followed by a homogenous vowel, the corresponding long vowel is the single substitute for both the precedent and the subsequent vowels.

Terms: संहितायाम्

The word राज्यम् has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when at the end of a तत्-पुरुष समास which is not a कर्मधारय समास ।

Terms: समास end acute-2nd-term
